verdict.rationale: The evidence documents the Microsoft Graph REST API for Outlook mail, including messages, rules, sendMail and change notifications, but never mentions an official SDK or client library. The get-started guide frames integration as raw HTTP requests in any language, which is a REST building block, not an official SDK. The axis applies to Outlook as a platform with a developer API, so the lack of SDK evidence yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
